panels.title: In one sentence
panels.description:
Over the dashboard's time range (3 months by default): how many Netomians used Cortex, their sessions, the leader, and Netomi's share of every Cortex session (customers' own users are the rest). Netomi = a Cortex user on Netomi's domain, or a playbook created from it (n360.settings adoption_staff_domain); customer users are counted, never named.

**Source:** n360.v_cortex_user  
**Filter:** Netomian, Customer  
**Window:** dashboard time range

targets.rawSql:
WITH (SELECT argMax(name, s) FROM (SELECT name, sum(sessions) AS s FROM n360.v_cortex_user WHERE who = 'Netomi' AND ifNull(name, '') IN (${netomian:singlequote}) AND account IN (${account:singlequote}) AND $__dateFilter(day) GROUP BY name)) AS leader,
             (SELECT max(s) FROM (SELECT name, sum(sessions) AS s FROM n360.v_cortex_user WHERE who = 'Netomi' AND ifNull(name, '') IN (${netomian:singlequote}) AND account IN (${account:singlequote}) AND $__dateFilter(day) GROUP BY name)) AS lead_n,
             (SELECT sum(sessions) FROM n360.v_cortex_user WHERE account IN (${account:singlequote}) AND $__dateFilter(day)) AS everyone
        SELECT if(count() = 0, NULL, concat(toString(uniqExact(name)), ' Netomians ran ', if(sum(sessions) IS NULL, NULL, if(sum(sessions) >= 1000000, concat(toString(intDiv(sum(sessions), 1000000)), ',', leftPad(toString(intDiv(sum(sessions), 1000) % 1000), 3, '0'), ',', leftPad(toString(sum(sessions) % 1000), 3, '0')), if(sum(sessions) >= 1000, concat(toString(intDiv(sum(sessions), 1000)), ',', leftPad(toString(sum(sessions) % 1000), 3, '0')), toString(sum(sessions))))),
                   ' Cortex sessions for ', concat(toString(uniqExact(account)), if(uniqExact(account) = 1, ' customer', ' customers')), ' · leader: ', leader, ' (',
                   toString(lead_n), ') · Netomi did ', toString(round(100 * sum(sessions) / nullIf(everyone, 0))),
                   '% of all Cortex sessions')) AS sentence
        FROM n360.v_cortex_user WHERE who = 'Netomi' AND ifNull(name, '') IN (${netomian:singlequote}) AND account IN (${account:singlequote}) AND $__dateFilter(day)

panels.title: Data
panels.description:
The last day of usage in this load, and the day it was loaded. Amber when the data is more than 2 days old (n360.settings stamp_stale_days): the numbers are the last good night's. Click for Pipeline health.

**Source:** n360.v_freshness (n360.runs: loaded runs only)  
**Filter:** none  
**Window:** the latest load

targets.rawSql: SELECT concat(stamp, if(stale, concat(' · ', toString(days_old), ' days old'), '')) AS stamp FROM n360.v_freshness

panels.title: Netomians in Cortex
panels.description:
Netomi users with at least one Cortex session in the range. Netomi = a Cortex user on Netomi's domain, or a playbook created from it (n360.settings adoption_staff_domain); customer users are counted, never named.

**Source:** n360.v_cortex_user  
**Filter:** Netomian, Customer  
**Window:** dashboard time range

targets.rawSql: SELECT if(count() = 0, NULL, uniqExact(name)) AS `with at least one session` FROM n360.v_cortex_user WHERE who = 'Netomi' AND ifNull(name, '') IN (${netomian:singlequote}) AND account IN (${account:singlequote}) AND $__dateFilter(day)

panels.title: Sessions by Netomians
panels.description:
Cortex sessions by Netomi users in the range. Netomi = a Cortex user on Netomi's domain, or a playbook created from it (n360.settings adoption_staff_domain); customer users are counted, never named.

**Source:** n360.v_cortex_user  
**Filter:** Netomian, Customer  
**Window:** dashboard time range

targets.rawSql: SELECT if(count() = 0, NULL, sum(sessions)) AS `in the range` FROM n360.v_cortex_user WHERE who = 'Netomi' AND ifNull(name, '') IN (${netomian:singlequote}) AND account IN (${account:singlequote}) AND $__dateFilter(day)

panels.title: Netomi's share of Cortex
panels.description:
Netomi users' sessions as a share of every Cortex session (Netomi and customers) in the range: lower means customers build for themselves. Netomi = a Cortex user on Netomi's domain, or a playbook created from it (n360.settings adoption_staff_domain); customer users are counted, never named.

**Source:** n360.v_cortex_user  
**Filter:** Customer  
**Window:** dashboard time range

targets.rawSql:
SELECT if(sum(sessions) = 0, NULL, round(100 * sumIf(sessions, who = 'Netomi') / sum(sessions), 1)) AS `of every session`
        FROM n360.v_cortex_user WHERE account IN (${account:singlequote}) AND $__dateFilter(day)

panels.title: Production edits by Netomians
panels.description:
Playbook versions Netomi users saved to a production playbook in the range: changes customers see. Netomi = a Cortex user on Netomi's domain, or a playbook created from it (n360.settings adoption_staff_domain); customer users are counted, never named.

**Source:** n360.v_cortex_user  
**Filter:** Netomian, Customer  
**Window:** dashboard time range

targets.rawSql: SELECT if(count() = 0, NULL, sum(production_edits)) AS `saved to live playbooks` FROM n360.v_cortex_user WHERE who = 'Netomi' AND ifNull(name, '') IN (${netomian:singlequote}) AND account IN (${account:singlequote}) AND $__dateFilter(day)

panels.title: Leaderboard
panels.description:
Every Netomian ranked by Cortex sessions in the range (3 months by default), with production edits, customers and VAs worked on. Last 30 days: their sessions in the newest 30 days, ▲ more than the 30 before, ▼ fewer. Click a name to see only them. Netomi = a Cortex user on Netomi's domain, or a playbook created from it (n360.settings adoption_staff_domain); customer users are counted, never named.

**Source:** n360.v_cortex_user  
**Filter:** Netomian, Customer  
**Window:** dashboard time range; last 30 days to the newest day read

targets.rawSql:
WITH (SELECT max(day) FROM n360.v_cortex_user) AS newest
        SELECT row_number() OVER (ORDER BY sum(sessions) DESC, name) AS `#`, name AS Netomian, sum(sessions) AS Sessions,
               sum(production_edits) AS `Production edits`, uniqExact(account) AS Customers, uniqExact(bot_id) AS VAs,
               multiIf(sumIf(sessions, day > newest - 30) > sumIf(sessions, day <= newest - 30 AND day > newest - 60),
                         concat('▲ ', toString(sumIf(sessions, day > newest - 30))),
                       sumIf(sessions, day > newest - 30) < sumIf(sessions, day <= newest - 30 AND day > newest - 60),
                         concat('▼ ', toString(sumIf(sessions, day > newest - 30))),
                       concat('● ', toString(sumIf(sessions, day > newest - 30)))) AS `Last 30 days`,
               concat(toString(toDayOfMonth(max(day))), ' ', formatDateTime(max(day), '%b %Y')) AS `Last active`
        FROM n360.v_cortex_user WHERE who = 'Netomi' AND ifNull(name, '') IN (${netomian:singlequote}) AND account IN (${account:singlequote}) AND $__dateFilter(day) GROUP BY name ORDER BY `#`

panels.title: Running leaderboard
panels.description:
Each Netomian's Cortex sessions added up day by day from the start of the range: the race. Where two lines cross, the lead changed hands. Hover for every Netomian that day, highest first. Netomi = a Cortex user on Netomi's domain, or a playbook created from it (n360.settings adoption_staff_domain); customer users are counted, never named.

**Source:** n360.v_cortex_user  
**Filter:** Netomian, Customer  
**Window:** dashboard time range

targets.rawSql:
SELECT toDateTime(day) AS time, name AS Netomian,
               sum(sum(sessions)) OVER (PARTITION BY name ORDER BY day ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS Sessions
        FROM n360.v_cortex_user WHERE who = 'Netomi' AND ifNull(name, '') IN (${netomian:singlequote}) AND account IN (${account:singlequote}) AND $__dateFilter(day) GROUP BY day, name ORDER BY time

panels.title: Sessions per week, by Netomian
panels.description:
Cortex sessions per week, stacked by Netomian: who carried each week. Hover for the week. Netomi = a Cortex user on Netomi's domain, or a playbook created from it (n360.settings adoption_staff_domain); customer users are counted, never named.

**Source:** n360.v_cortex_user  
**Filter:** Netomian, Customer  
**Window:** dashboard time range, weeks from Monday

targets.rawSql:
SELECT toDateTime(toMonday(day)) AS time, name AS Netomian, sum(sessions) AS Sessions
        FROM n360.v_cortex_user WHERE who = 'Netomi' AND ifNull(name, '') IN (${netomian:singlequote}) AND account IN (${account:singlequote}) AND $__dateFilter(day) GROUP BY time, name ORDER BY time

panels.title: Cortex sessions per week: Netomi and the customer
panels.description:
Cortex sessions per week by Netomi users and by the customer's own users, side by side. The customer's line rising while Netomi's falls is the hand-over working. Hover for the week. Netomi = a Cortex user on Netomi's domain, or a playbook created from it (n360.settings adoption_staff_domain); customer users are counted, never named.

**Source:** n360.v_cortex_user  
**Filter:** Customer  
**Window:** dashboard time range, weeks from Monday

targets.rawSql:
SELECT toDateTime(toMonday(day)) AS time, sumIf(sessions, who = 'Netomi') AS Netomi,
               sumIf(sessions, who = 'Customer') AS `The customer`
        FROM n360.v_cortex_user WHERE account IN (${account:singlequote}) AND $__dateFilter(day) GROUP BY time ORDER BY time

panels.title: Who works where
panels.description:
Each Netomian's Cortex work per customer in the range. Click a customer for its adoption page. Netomi = a Cortex user on Netomi's domain, or a playbook created from it (n360.settings adoption_staff_domain); customer users are counted, never named.

**Source:** n360.v_cortex_user  
**Filter:** Netomian, Customer  
**Window:** dashboard time range

targets.rawSql:
SELECT name AS Netomian, a.display_name AS Customer, sum(c.sessions) AS Sessions, sum(c.production_edits) AS `Production edits`,
               concat(toString(toDayOfMonth(max(c.day))), ' ', formatDateTime(max(c.day), '%b %Y')) AS `Last active`, c.account AS account
        FROM n360.v_cortex_user AS c INNER JOIN n360.account AS a ON a.account = c.account
        WHERE c.who = 'Netomi' AND ifNull(c.name, '') IN (${netomian:singlequote}) AND c.account IN (${account:singlequote}) AND $__dateFilter(c.day)
        GROUP BY name, a.display_name, c.account ORDER BY Netomian, Sessions DESC

panels.title: Cortex sessions: Netomi and the customer
panels.description:
Cortex sessions per customer, split by who ran them: Netomi (blue-grey) or the customer's own users (green). Hover for the counts. A customer whose bar is all Netomi depends on Netomi to change its playbooks. Netomi = a Cortex user on Netomi's domain, or a playbook created from it (n360.settings adoption_staff_domain); customer users are counted, never named.

**Source:** n360.v_cortex_user  
**Filter:** Customer  
**Window:** dashboard time range

targets.rawSql:
SELECT a.display_name AS Customer, sumIf(c.sessions, c.who = 'Netomi') AS Netomi,
               sumIf(c.sessions, c.who = 'Customer') AS `The customer`
        FROM n360.v_cortex_user AS c INNER JOIN n360.account AS a ON a.account = c.account
        WHERE c.account IN (${account:singlequote}) AND $__dateFilter(c.day) GROUP BY Customer ORDER BY sum(c.sessions) DESC
